objective: Jointly fit packet selection and atomic logical answer decoding. Freeze both before new identifiable wiring and test exact minimum three- and four-bit communication on every one of 512 relations.
status: With varied training the frozen NAND decoder answered all 344,064 held queries. Its sender reached minimum width on 150/168 wirings, including all canonical three-bit and four-bit cases. Training only on disjunction missed exactly-one transfer. On the hardest compound wiring the sender used nine bits where four suffice.
title: Learn what to send and decode unfamiliar logical questions
